# {{ site.Title }}

> Christos Kalyvas-Kasopatidis, PhD, is an AI security architect working on the security of AI and LLM systems (AI security controls and governance, shadow-AI detection, prompt-injection testing and guardrail evaluation, agentic AI threat modelling), AI for cyber defence and vulnerability intelligence. His research background is in machine learning and multi-objective (skyline / Pareto) optimisation over big data (PhD, University of the Aegean).

This site has two parts: a blog at the root and an academic profile under /profile/.

## Profile

- [Profile and bio]({{ "profile/" | absURL }}): biography, research interests, education
- [Experience]({{ "profile/experience/" | absURL }}): positions, skills, certifications
- [Publications]({{ "profile/publication/" | absURL }}): journal articles, conference papers and preprints with DOIs
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0901-3580)
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=YKAgHFsAAAAJ)

## Sections

- [Vulnerability Intelligence]({{ "vulnerability-intelligence/" | absURL }}): discovery, cataloguing, prioritisation and exploitation of vulnerabilities
- [Off Watch]({{ "off-watch/" | absURL }}): non-research writing, including [Nautical]({{ "off-watch/nautical/" | absURL }}) (sailing, navigation, seamanship)
